slides.fact: _kiss and hug_: a sweet way to end a message to someone close to you.

slides.title: Kram is everywhere
slides.body:
Swedes end lots of messages to friends with just *kram*, a hug.

*Puss* is for partners, kids and close family.

slides.sv: Vi ses på fredag. *Puss och kram*, mamma
slides.en: See you on Friday. Hugs and kisses, Mum

caption:
Puss och kram: kiss and hug. It's how many Swedes sign off messages to the people closest to them.

For friends, a simple "kram" (hug) is very common. For work emails, stick to "hälsningar".

How do you sign off your messages?
